name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Goat of Traveling

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This figurine can become a Large goat with the same statistics as a Riding Horse. It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. While it has charges, you can use it as often as you wish. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended charges.

gaps.name: Seven-day lockout and full charge restoration after the last charge is spent
